body:
The way we render widgets in InstantSearch.js right now cannot be decoupled from the library lifecycle. The widgets' templates expect strings in return and inject them in our internal Preact components. Thus, it's not possible to use `lit-html` to control the full rendering.

It is however possible to create a web component InstantSearch flavor based on the [connectors](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/widgets/customize-an-existing-widget/js/#anatomy-of-a-connector).
